import os
import re
from datetime import datetime
from openpyxl import load_workbook

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/51958/1_51958_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/51958_1_cea76735/1_51958_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

source = ws["A2"].value

# Parse formats like: "9th Aug 10:08", "21st September 7:05", etc.
text = str(source).strip()
m = re.match(
    r"^\s*(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*$",
    text,
    flags=re.IGNORECASE
)

if not m:
    raise ValueError(f"Could not parse date/time value in A2: {source!r}")

day = int(m.group(1))
month_name = m.group(2)
hour = int(m.group(3))
minute = int(m.group(4))

month_lookup = {
    "jan": 1, "january": 1,
    "feb": 2, "february": 2,
    "mar": 3, "march": 3,
    "apr": 4, "april": 4,
    "may": 5,
    "jun": 6, "june": 6,
    "jul": 7, "july": 7,
    "aug": 8, "august": 8,
    "sep": 9, "sept": 9, "september": 9,
    "oct": 10, "october": 10,
    "nov": 11, "november": 11,
    "dec": 12, "december": 12,
}

month = month_lookup[month_name.lower()]

# Source data omits the year; the required standardized example uses yy = 21.
standardized_dt = datetime(2021, month, day, hour, minute)

ws["B2"].value = standardized_dt
ws["B2"].number_format = "dd/mm/yy hh:mm"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
